content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Digital products

Sovereign commerce infrastructure refers to a self-hosted and completely owned solution that empowers digital creators to sell products independently of restrictive platforms like Stripe and PayPal. This matters because many creators are locked out of mainstream payment processing, which stifles their ability to earn a living. By utilizing a sovereign stack, these creators can bypass the barriers imposed by these platforms, ensuring they retain full control over their sales and revenue.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of sovereign commerce infrastructure is designed to be robust and flexible. It leverages free technologies like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. This setup allows creators to deploy their online stores with minimal cost while ensuring that all transactions are secure and efficiently handled. The use of open-source tools also means that creators can customize their stacks to meet their specific needs.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically built for digital creators in regions where traditional payment processors are unavailable or heavily restricted. These include countries across Africa and parts of Asia and Latin America. For creators selling ebooks, courses, or digital assets, the ability to independently process payments without relying on platforms that may suspend their accounts or restrict access is crucial for their business sustainability.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure ensures you own everything after deployment.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The sovereign commerce stack consists of several key components that work in harmony. Hosting is handled by platforms like Cloudflare or GitHub, while order storage can be managed through Supabase or Google Sheets. File delivery utilizes Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The integration of NOWPayments allows for real-time crypto payment verification, ensuring that creators can receive payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies. This combination creates a seamless experience for both the seller and the buyer.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start selling your digital products without relying on Stripe, begin by selecting a hosting platform like Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend using Google Apps Script. Use Supabase for storing your orders and Google Drive for file delivery. Finally, integrate NOWPayments for processing transactions. For a complete solution, consider deploying the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which includes everything needed to get your store operational in just 48 hours.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If Stripe is not available in your country, you can sell digital products by leveraging sovereign commerce infrastructure. This approach utilizes free tools and crypto payment processors like NOWPayments to enable seamless transactions without reliance on restricted platforms. This ensures that you retain full control over your sales process and funds.
No subscriptions or platform dependencies mean true financial independence.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
Frequently Asked Questions
What are my options if Stripe is not available?
Consider using sovereign commerce infrastructure that allows you to process payments through crypto providers like NOWPayments. This eliminates reliance on traditional payment processors.
Can I use PayPal if I am in Nigeria or Ghana?
PayPal services may be limited in Nigeria and Ghana, and account suspensions can lead to held funds. It's advisable to explore alternatives that ensure full control.
How do I set up an online store without Gumroad?
Utilize free hosting solutions like GitHub Pages alongside NOWPayments for payment processing. This setup gives you the freedom to manage your store independently.
What types of products can I sell?
You can sell a variety of digital products, including ebooks, courses, templates, and software. The sovereign stack supports multiple product types seamlessly.
Is there support available once I deploy my stack?
Yes, when you choose solutions like the Edge Commerce Stack, you receive 30-day support to help you navigate any challenges after deployment.
